title: Authorization Code Flow
summary: The authorization code flow is an OAuth 2.0 grant type where the user authorizes the app, and an authorization code is exchanged for an access token.

content.overview: This involving redirecting the user to the authorization server's endpoint, the user granting permission, and the server returning an authorization code.
content.details: The flow consists of: 1) user initiates login; 2) redirect to provider; 3) user grants permission; 4) provider redirects back with authorization code; 5) exchange code for access token. The token is then used for API calls.
